description: This file defines the TVFadeOut class within the YAHOO.widget namespace, providing an animation to fade out a DOM element by reducing opacity over a duration and then hiding it. It includes methods for animating the fade-out effect and handling completion.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVFadeOut
classes.description: A class that manages fading out a DOM element with a callback upon completion.

methods.name: animate()
methods.description: Performs the fade-out animation by decreasing opacity to 0.1 over 0.4 seconds and sets an event handler for completion.

methods.name: onComplete()
methods.description: Hides the element by setting display to 'none' and resets opacity filter, then calls the provided callback.
